mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increases the risk of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes with dronedarone's Class III antiarrhythmic activity.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; maintain levels in upper normal range; consider alternative diuretic or add potassium-sparing agent; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
